```{r}
# ---------------------------
# 0. Setup
# ---------------------------
# install pacman if missing
if (!requireNamespace("pacman", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("pacman")

pacman::p_load(
  sf, terra, tidyverse, tmap, spdep, Kendall,
  knitr, readr, lubridate
)

# ensure tmap plotting mode
tmap_mode("plot")

# create outputs dir
if (!dir.exists("outputs")) dir.create("outputs")
```

```{r}
# ---------------------------
# 1. Read data
# ---------------------------
mpsz <- read_rds("data/rds/mpsz_sf.rds")  # study area polygons
BusStop <- st_read(dsn = "data/geospatial/", layer = "BusStop", quiet = TRUE)
odbus <- read_csv("data/aspatial/origin_destination_bus_202508.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# examine CRSes; convert everything to Singapore CRS (EPSG:3414) for distance calculations
target_crs <- 3414
mpsz <- st_transform(mpsz, crs = target_crs)
BusStop <- st_transform(BusStop, crs = target_crs)
```

```{r}
# ---------------------------
# 2. Derive hexagon grid (apothem = 375 m)
# ---------------------------
hex_cells <- st_make_grid(mpsz,
                          cellsize = 750,   # 2 * 375 (apothem -> edge-to-edge)
                          what = "polygons",
                          square = FALSE) %>%
  st_sf() %>%
  st_set_crs(st_crs(mpsz))

# clip hexagons to study area union (no sea)
hex_cells <- st_intersection(hex_cells, st_union(mpsz))

# assign HEX_ID
hex_cells$HEX_ID <- sprintf("H%04d", seq_len(nrow(hex_cells))) %>% as.factor()

# save intermediate hexagon for inspection
st_write(hex_cells, "outputs/hexagon_grid_375m.geojson", delete_dsn = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# ---------------------------
# 3. Filter bus stops inside study area and join to hexagon
# ---------------------------
possible_code_cols <- c("BUS_STOP_N", "BUS_STOP_CODE", "bus_stop_code", "BUSSTOPCODE", "busstopcode", "BusStopCode")
code_col <- intersect(possible_code_cols, names(BusStop)) %>% first()
if (is.null(code_col) || length(code_col) == 0) {
  # fallback: try common field "bus_stop_code" or "busstopcode" else use first non-geometry column
  code_col <- names(BusStop)[1]
  message("Warning: could not find standard bus stop code column; using ", code_col)
}

# rename to BUS_STOP_N for convenience
BusStop <- BusStop %>% rename(BUS_STOP_N = all_of(code_col))

BusStop_in <- st_join(BusStop, mpsz, join = st_within, left = FALSE)
BusStop_in <- st_transform(BusStop_in, st_crs(hex_cells))

# intersect bus stops with hex cells to attach HEX_ID
bs_hex <- st_intersection(st_geometry(BusStop_in), st_geometry(hex_cells)) # geometry-only intersection
# better: use spatial join to retain attributes
bs_hex <- st_join(BusStop_in, hex_cells %>% select(HEX_ID), join = st_within, left = FALSE)
bs_hex <- bs_hex %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% distinct(BUS_STOP_N, HEX_ID)

# ensure consistent types
bs_hex$BUS_STOP_N <- as.character(bs_hex$BUS_STOP_N)
```

```{r}
# ---------------------------
# 4. Prepare trips data and map to hex
# ---------------------------
expected_cols <- c("ORIGIN_PT_CODE", "DAY_TYPE", "TIME_PER_HOUR", "TOTAL_TRIPS")
if (!all(expected_cols %in% names(odbus))) {
  stop("odbus missing expected columns. Found: ", paste(names(odbus), collapse = ", "))
}

trips <- odbus %>%
  select(ORIGIN_PT_CODE, DAY_TYPE, TIME_PER_HOUR, TOTAL_TRIPS) %>%
  rename(BUS_STOP_N = ORIGIN_PT_CODE,
         HOUR_RAW = TIME_PER_HOUR,
         DAY_TYPE = DAY_TYPE,
         TRPS = TOTAL_TRIPS) %>%
  mutate(BUS_STOP_N = as.character(BUS_STOP_N))

parse_hour <- function(x) {
  # handle numeric
  if (is.numeric(x)) return(as.integer(x))
  # handle character like "06:00" or "6"
  x_chr <- as.character(x)
  # try to parse first two digits before ":" or non-digit
  res <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(substr(x_chr, 1, 2)))
  if (!is.na(res)) return(res)
  # fallback: parse digits
  digits <- stringr::str_extract(x_chr, "\\d{1,2}")
  as.integer(digits)
}
trips <- trips %>% mutate(HOUR = parse_hour(HOUR_RAW))

# join trips to hex via bs_hex
trips <- inner_join(trips, bs_hex, by = "BUS_STOP_N")
```

```{r}
# ---------------------------
# 5. Define periods and aggregate trips to hexagon level
# ---------------------------
# Standardize DAY_TYPE values to uppercase to match possibilities
trips <- trips %>% mutate(DAY_TYPE_UP = toupper(DAY_TYPE))

trips <- trips %>%
  mutate(
    PERIOD = case_when(
      DAY_TYPE_UP %in% c("WEEKDAY", "WEEKDAY/PH", "WEEKDAY/PH?") & HOUR >= 6  & HOUR <= 8  ~ "WK_MORNING",
      DAY_TYPE_UP %in% c("WEEKDAY", "WEEKDAY/PH", "WEEKDAY/PH?") & HOUR >= 17 & HOUR <= 19 ~ "WK_AFTERNOON",
      DAY_TYPE_UP %in% c("WEEKEND", "WEEKEND/HOL", "SAT/SUN", "HOLIDAY", "PH") & HOUR >= 11 & HOUR <= 19 ~ "WKND_HOL",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(PERIOD))

# aggregate: trips per HEX_ID x PERIOD
hex_period_sum <- trips %>%
  group_by(HEX_ID, PERIOD) %>%
  summarise(TRPS = sum(as.numeric(TRPS), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# pivot to wide format (one column per period)
hex_period_wide <- hex_period_sum %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = PERIOD, values_from = TRPS, values_fill = 0)

# join aggregated trips back to hex_cells
hex_cells <- left_join(hex_cells, hex_period_wide, by = "HEX_ID")

# ensure columns exist
for (col in c("WK_MORNING", "WK_AFTERNOON", "WKND_HOL")) {
  if (!(col %in% names(hex_cells))) hex_cells[[col]] <- 0
  hex_cells[[col]][is.na(hex_cells[[col]])] <- 0
}

# Save aggregated table
write_csv(st_drop_geometry(hex_cells) %>% select(HEX_ID, WK_MORNING, WK_AFTERNOON, WKND_HOL),
          "outputs/hex_trips_by_period.csv")
```

```{r}
# ---------------------------
# 6. Geovisualisation: maps of passenger trips by hexagon for each period
# ---------------------------
breaks_fun <- function(x) {
  # compute pretty breaks including 0
  x_nonzero <- x[x > 0]
  if (length(x_nonzero) == 0) return(c(0))
  br <- classInt::classIntervals(x_nonzero, n = 5, style = "jenks")$brks
  unique(c(0, br))
}

# Weekday morning map
b_wm <- breaks_fun(hex_cells$WK_MORNING)
map_wm <- tm_shape(hex_cells) +
  tm_polygons("WK_MORNING", style = "fixed", breaks = b_wm,
              title = "Trips (WK Morning)") +
  tm_shape(mpsz) + tm_borders(alpha = 0.4) +
  tm_layout(main.title = "Passenger trips by origin — Weekday Morning (06:00-08:59)")
tmap_save(map_wm, "outputs/map_trips_wk_morning.png", width = 1200, height = 900)

# Weekday afternoon map
b_wa <- breaks_fun(hex_cells$WK_AFTERNOON)
map_wa <- tm_shape(hex_cells) +
  tm_polygons("WK_AFTERNOON", style = "fixed", breaks = b_wa,
              title = "Trips (WK Afternoon)") +
  tm_shape(mpsz) + tm_borders(alpha = 0.4) +
  tm_layout(main.title = "Passenger trips by origin — Weekday Afternoon (17:00-19:59)")
tmap_save(map_wa, "outputs/map_trips_wk_afternoon.png", width = 1200, height = 900)

# Weekend/holiday map
b_wh <- breaks_fun(hex_cells$WKND_HOL)
map_wh <- tm_shape(hex_cells) +
  tm_polygons("WKND_HOL", style = "fixed", breaks = b_wh,
              title = "Trips (Weekend/Holiday)") +
  tm_shape(mpsz) + tm_borders(alpha = 0.4) +
  tm_layout(main.title = "Passenger trips by origin — Weekend/Holiday (11:00-19:59)")
tmap_save(map_wh, "outputs/map_trips_wknd_hol.png", width = 1200, height = 900)
```

```{r}
# ---------------------------
# 7. Local Measures of Spatial Autocorrelation (LMSA)
# ---------------------------
# Ensure validity
hex_cells <- st_make_valid(hex_cells)

nb <- poly2nb(hex_cells, queen = FALSE)
# handle isolated polygons (no neighbors)
no_nb <- which(card(nb) == 0)
if (length(no_nb) > 0) {
  cent <- st_centroid(st_geometry(hex_cells))
  for (i in no_nb) {
    d <- as.numeric(st_distance(cent[i], cent))
    d[i] <- Inf
    nb[[i]] <- which.min(d)
  }
}
listw <- nb2listw(nb, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)

# helper to run localmoran and localG robustly
safe_localmoran <- function(x, lw) {
  lm <- localmoran(x, lw, zero.policy = TRUE)
  out <- tibble(I = lm[,1], Z = if (ncol(lm) >= 4) lm[,4] else NA_real_,
                P = if (ncol(lm) >= 5) lm[,5] else NA_real_)
  out
}
safe_localG <- function(x, lw) {
  gz <- localG(x, lw, zero.policy = TRUE)
  z <- as.numeric(gz)
  p <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(z))
  tibble(Gz = z, Gp = p)
}

# compute for each period
lm_wm <- safe_localmoran(hex_cells$WK_MORNING, listw)
lm_wa <- safe_localmoran(hex_cells$WK_AFTERNOON, listw)
lm_wk <- safe_localmoran(hex_cells$WKND_HOL, listw)

gi_wm <- safe_localG(hex_cells$WK_MORNING, listw)
gi_wa <- safe_localG(hex_cells$WK_AFTERNOON, listw)
gi_wk <- safe_localG(hex_cells$WKND_HOL, listw)

# attach to hex_cells
hex_cells <- hex_cells %>%
  mutate(
    I_WM = lm_wm$I, I_WM_p = lm_wm$P,
    I_WA = lm_wa$I, I_WA_p = lm_wa$P,
    I_WK = lm_wk$I, I_WK_p = lm_wk$P,
    Gi_WM_z = gi_wm$Gz, Gi_WM_p = gi_wm$Gp,
    Gi_WA_z = gi_wa$Gz, Gi_WA_p = gi_wa$Gp,
    Gi_WK_z = gi_wk$Gz, Gi_WK_p = gi_wk$Gp
  )

# Save with LMSA stats
st_write(hex_cells, "outputs/hex_lmsa_full.geojson", delete_dsn = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)

sig_threshold <- 0.05

# helper to produce Gi* significance map for a period
plot_gi_sig <- function(hex_sf, zcol, pcol, title, fname) {
  sig_hex <- filter(hex_sf, !!sym(pcol) < sig_threshold)
  # if no significant features, produce empty message
  if (nrow(sig_hex) == 0) {
    message("No significant Gi* for ", title)
    return(NULL)
  }
  zvals <- sig_hex[[zcol]]
  brks <- c(-Inf, -2.58, -1.96, 0, 1.96, 2.58, Inf)  # conventional z breaks
  m <- tm_shape(hex_sf) +
    tm_polygons(col = NA, border.col = "grey90") +
    tm_shape(sig_hex) +
    tm_polygons(col = zcol, style = "fixed", breaks = brks, title = paste0("Gi* z (sig)"),
                palette = "-RdYlBu") +
    tm_shape(mpsz) + tm_borders(alpha = 0.4) +
    tm_layout(main.title = title)
  tmap_save(m, fname, width = 1200, height = 900)
  invisible(m)
}

plot_gi_sig(hex_cells, "Gi_WM_z", "Gi_WM_p", "Getis-Ord Gi* (Weekday Morning) — significant (p<0.05)", "outputs/Gi_sig_wk_morning.png")
plot_gi_sig(hex_cells, "Gi_WA_z", "Gi_WA_p", "Getis-Ord Gi* (Weekday Afternoon) — significant (p<0.05)", "outputs/Gi_sig_wk_afternoon.png")
plot_gi_sig(hex_cells, "Gi_WK_z", "Gi_WK_p", "Getis-Ord Gi* (Weekend/Holiday) — significant (p<0.05)", "outputs/Gi_sig_wknd_hol.png")

# Also produce Local Moran (I) significance maps if you want (similar approach)
plot_I_sig <- function(hex_sf, icol, pcol, title, fname) {
  sig_hex <- filter(hex_sf, !!sym(pcol) < sig_threshold)
  if (nrow(sig_hex) == 0) {
    message("No significant Local Moran for ", title)
    return(NULL)
  }
  m <- tm_shape(hex_sf) +
    tm_polygons(col = NA, border.col = "grey90") +
    tm_shape(sig_hex) +
    tm_polygons(col = icol, style = "quantile", n = 5, title = paste0("Local Moran I (sig)")) +
    tm_shape(mpsz) + tm_borders(alpha = 0.4) +
    tm_layout(main.title = title)
  tmap_save(m, fname, width = 1200, height = 900)
  invisible(m)
}

plot_I_sig(hex_cells, "I_WM", "I_WM_p", "Local Moran's I (Weekday Morning) — significant (p<0.05)", "outputs/LocalMoran_sig_wk_morning.png")
plot_I_sig(hex_cells, "I_WA", "I_WA_p", "Local Moran's I (Weekday Afternoon) — significant (p<0.05)", "outputs/LocalMoran_sig_wk_afternoon.png")
plot_I_sig(hex_cells, "I_WK", "I_WK_p", "Local Moran's I (Weekend/Holiday) — significant (p<0.05)", "outputs/LocalMoran_sig_wknd_hol.png")
```

```{r}
# ---------------------------
# 8. Emerging Hot Spot Analysis (EHSA) — simplified approach
# ---------------------------
# prepare matrix of Gi* z-scores in chronological order: morning -> afternoon -> weekend
gi_mat <- hex_cells %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  transmute(HEX_ID, v1 = Gi_WM_z, v2 = Gi_WA_z, v3 = Gi_WK_z)

# Mann-Kendall requires >= 3 observations; we have 3 time slices
mk_apply <- function(x) {
  # x is numeric vector length 3
  if (all(is.na(x))) return(list(tau = NA_real_, p = NA_real_))
  res <- tryCatch(MannKendall(x), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(res)) return(list(tau = NA_real_, p = NA_real_))
  list(tau = as.numeric(res$tau), p = as.numeric(res$sl))
}

mk_out <- t(apply(as.matrix(gi_mat[, c("v1","v2","v3")]), 1, function(r) {
  out <- mk_apply(r)
  c(tau = out$tau, p = out$p)
}))
mk_df <- tibble(HEX_ID = gi_mat$HEX_ID, mk_tau = mk_out[, "tau"], mk_p = mk_out[, "p"])

# attach to hex_cells
hex_cells <- left_join(hex_cells, mk_df, by = "HEX_ID")

# define significance for Gi* per period
hex_cells <- hex_cells %>%
  mutate(
    pos_sig = (Gi_WM_z > 0 & Gi_WM_p < 0.05) | (Gi_WA_z > 0 & Gi_WA_p < 0.05) | (Gi_WK_z > 0 & Gi_WK_p < 0.05),
    neg_sig = (Gi_WM_z < 0 & Gi_WM_p < 0.05) | (Gi_WA_z < 0 & Gi_WA_p < 0.05) | (Gi_WK_z < 0 & Gi_WK_p < 0.05),
    EHSA = case_when(
      pos_sig & mk_tau > 0 & mk_p < 0.05 ~ "Intensifying_Hotspot",
      pos_sig & mk_tau < 0 & mk_p < 0.05 ~ "Diminishing_Hotspot",
      pos_sig & mk_p >= 0.05 ~ "Sporadic_Hotspot",
      neg_sig & mk_tau < 0 & mk_p < 0.05 ~ "Intensifying_Coldspot",
      neg_sig & mk_tau > 0 & mk_p < 0.05 ~ "Diminishing_Coldspot",
      neg_sig & mk_p >= 0.05 ~ "Sporadic_Coldspot",
      TRUE ~ "Not_Significant"
    )
  )

# Save EHSA results
st_write(hex_cells, "outputs/hex_ehsa.geojson", delete_dsn = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)

# Map EHSA: show only significant categories (i.e., not "Not_Significant")
ehsa_sig <- filter(hex_cells, EHSA != "Not_Significant")
if (nrow(ehsa_sig) > 0) {
  # prepare a color palette mapping for categories
  cats <- sort(unique(ehsa_sig$EHSA))
  # make a friendly palette
  pal <- c(
    "Intensifying_Hotspot" = "#d73027",
    "Diminishing_Hotspot" = "#fc8d59",
    "Sporadic_Hotspot" = "#fdd49e",
    "Intensifying_Coldspot" = "#4575b4",
    "Diminishing_Coldspot" = "#74add1",
    "Sporadic_Coldspot" = "#c6dbef"
  )
  pal_used <- pal[names(pal) %in% cats]
  ehsa_map <- tm_shape(hex_cells) +
    tm_polygons(col = NA, border.col = "grey90") +
    tm_shape(ehsa_sig) +
    tm_polygons("EHSA", palette = pal_used, title = "EHSA (sig only)") +
    tm_shape(mpsz) + tm_borders(alpha = 0.4) +
    tm_layout(main.title = "Simplified EHSA categories (significant only)")
  tmap_save(ehsa_map, "outputs/ehsa_sig_map.png", width = 1200, height = 900)
} else {
  message("No significant EHSA categories found (no hexagon labelled significant).")
}
```
